01 / 05Full coverage

All calls monitored.

Every live call is scored by AI while it is still running. Managers see the whole floor at once instead of a random sample of recordings.

  • One live command view. Every agent on one radar. Anyone in trouble turns red right away.
  • AI scoring on 100% of calls. Score, interaction quality and attention flags for each call in one table.
  • Instant alerts. Dead air, a call stuck in one stage, risky claims. Each alert has a one-click "View live call".
02 / 05Objection handling

Sales improve fast.

When a customer pushes back, the agent gets the next move on screen during the call. The fix happens on this call, not in a review next week.

  • Live tips with the exact words. The agent sees what to say next, timed to the moment in the call.
  • Guided next step, with the reason. "Finish Opening & Context within 30 s, then move to Activation."
  • Signals as they happen. Objections, frustration and buying signals are flagged live.
  • Backup on hard calls. Whisper and Call for Help bring a manager in before the deal is lost.

Live tip · 0:14"What results or outcomes were you hoping to achieve with us?"

03 / 05Risk & governance

Compliance risk, dramatically lower.

Ausculta catches the risky moment while the customer is still on the line, when there is still time to fix it.

  • Misleading claims flagged. For example, an agent promising guaranteed profits or zero risk.
  • Critical alerts for managers. A customer questions the company's legitimacy? The manager can view the live call in one click.
  • Audit-ready every day. Automated monitoring, an audit trail and tamper-proof evidence capture. No blind spots.
04 / 05Agent coaching

New agents ramp faster.

Every call becomes a coaching session. New agents get guidance during the call, and managers know exactly who needs help and with what.

  • Focus Mode for beginners. One clear instruction on screen while the call runs. Agents are tagged by experience level.
  • Automatic evaluation after every call. Active listening, product knowledge, negotiation, time and rapport, plus next steps.
  • Ask in plain words. "Who is my best agent?" The AI assistant answers with the data and a chart.
  • Needs-attention cards. Low-scoring agents are flagged with a coaching recommendation.
